message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration features a close-up profile of a light-skinned man wearing round spectacles. His nose is elongated into a smooth, horizontal, flesh-toned cylinder. A rectangular, crumpled slip of paper with printed text and a signature is taped over his mouth. He is wearing a dark suit jacket and a striped tie.

The background is solid pale yellow. At the top, bold red serif text reads "TEMPO". Above this, a dark blue banner contains white sans-serif text: "Theys Dibunuh: Nasib Otonomi Papua?". Below "TEMPO" is "EDISI 19 - 25 November 2001". To the left of the man, black bold sans-serif text asks, "Akbar, Permainan Apa Lagi". Below this, red sans-serif text reads, "Dua lembar kuitansi Bulog mengungkapkan keterlibatan para petinggi Golkar."

The bottom left corner has a barcode and the numbers "9 770126 427302" and "00038". Centered at the bottom is "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN", and at the bottom right is "Rp 10.800". The man’s gaze is directed downward and toward the left.
